composition_variation: Create a calm gouache anime illustration of Gaara seated on a simple wooden stool inside a desert greenhouse. His open hand rests beside a tiny potted cactus on a low table, with no equipment attached to him. Use terracotta pots, sage succulents, dusty rose sand, soft filtered light, and airy glass above. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
